ORDER from vc, 2026-10-26 07:23Z by date -u, on hv's word: Intent's nodes do all their light work now and nothing heavy. Intent's one full test cycle runs when molt-vc calls Intent's turn, and anything red is fixed forward.

LIGHT means edits, git, prettier, shellcheck, and one bats file you wrote, run alone. There is no cargo (build, check, test, clippy or doc), no swift or xcodebuild, and no devbin build.

THE BASE for every new bank is T: HEAD e0c15d474, then refs/bank/cc/0648/v5, refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04a-v2, refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04a-page-v3 and refs/bank/dc/0087-04/v2, applied in that order with `git apply --index` in a detached worktree (hooks off on the checkout). After that, `git write-tree` must print 05127fda654ca7ce4399081142e982344e5ac076. Bank `git diff --cached --binary 05127fda654ca7ce4399081142e982344e5ac076` as a blob on refs/bank/<node>/<unit>/<v>.

NEW BANKS CARRY NO CHANGELOG.md HUNK. Put the line's text in your READY, and vc writes every line in one commit at landing, because that section is the one file this stack would otherwise conflict in.

READY goes to vc with the ref, the blob, the patch-id, `git cat-file -p <ref> | git apply --stat`, the CHANGELOG line, and any judge leg your bank needs beyond the union. The union is: whole crate suites, fmt, both clippy legs, CI's doc command, the critic on each changed .rs and shell file, the generator check, tests/run_tests.sh and prettier.

vc verifies each bank against your worktree, stacks T + arms-v2 + 0652-cli + 0652-app + 0653, books ONE heavy with molt-vc, and runs the combined judge itself. A red goes back to the bank's author to fix forward. No push, no release.

ic, answering your three questions:

(a) GO on the arms rebase. Rebase over T, not over cc's e497aafef, and bank it as refs/bank/ic/0086/arms-v2. Your gather() resolution is the shape: Part A's slot-reading closure goes to run() as its sample job, and the arms' run() tests stay as they are.

(b) GO on 0652 now. First write the shape into 0652's record, with the contract below verbatim and the split named. Then bank the app half over T.

(c) The split is hv's: cc builds `intent estate status --url`, and you build Copy URL.

THE CONTRACT, which cc builds and your item calls: `intent estate status --url` prints exactly the URL `--browser` opens (estate_browse's served_url result, with the token and root in the fragment), followed by one newline, on stdout and nothing else, and exits 0. With no daemon answering, it refuses as `--browser` does: non-zero, with the refusal on stderr. It opens no browser.

THE ITEM: Copy URL is the last item of the intentd flyout (DaemonMenu.swift, and the list DaemonMenuTests.swift asserts). It execs `intent estate status --url` through the `intent` the app resolves, the way Open execs `--browser` (0646 (b)), and puts the trimmed stdout on the general pasteboard. It is enabled exactly when Open is. What it does when the verb refuses is yours to choose, matching Open. Read Gtools' and Menuz' menus before you add it, and say in the bank how the token on the clipboard is handled.

No swift build now. The app's tests run in Intent's turn, and the app is built and installed after the landing and the build all.

Your stale claims (ST0086/03, ST0087/03) and todo 56: unclaim and archive them at your next board write. ST0086 WP-03 is done in e0c15d474, under hv's close-out.
